rationale: Kinome KO screen (Addgene #75314, 3,149 guides on 764 genes, 100 non-targeting) in H358 parental cells (DMSO) and sotorasib-resistant H358-AMGR cells (on sotorasib) for 2 weeks. Column names match GSM titles (Ref1 = parental T0, Ref2 = AMGR T0, two T1 replicate cultures per line). GEO: 'depleted sgRNAs in sotorasib-R H358 cells compared to reference or parental cells'. Primary analysis compares end points directly (2 vs 2); the second fits line x time with each line's single T0 reference so the interaction asks whether a knockout drops out more in AMGR than in parental cells relative to each line's own starting library (residual df 2; the T0 references are single libraries). T1 replicates are not paired across lines, so no replicate term.
